title: Energy hungry Big Tech turn to carbon credits to fuel data centers while remaining committed to net-zero emissions | TechRadar
summary: Big Tech companies like Amazon, Google, Meta, and Microsoft are increasingly purchasing carbon credits to offset emissions from energy-intensive data centers, amidst rapid AI expansion and net-zero sustainability goals. Despite investments in renewable energy and efficiency, carbon credits remain a key tool for these companies to manage their carbon footprint.
sentiment_reason: The article presents a negative sentiment due to the reliance on carbon credits to meet net-zero goals amidst the expansion of data centers, indicating a struggle to balance growth with sustainability.
